real_defects.issue: PR #18757 hand-wrote photo-editing's subscription model into the generated file; transition.py never produced it, so test_committed_json_is_current (an unwired suite run on every venture PR) was red on main. Decision moved into transition.py OVERRIDES; --write now reproduces it plus the model counts the hand edit missed.
ConcatenatedJson tests sat below the __main__ guard (added in #18749); check_main_guard_last.py was red on main. Guard moved to the end.

A node suite whose package.json dependency was not installed (platform/aws/stacks/saas-starter/runtime, #18765) counted as red, unlike a missing pip package, so every venture PR inherited two reds. Now a SKIP with an npm ci hint; undeclared packages stay red. The suites pass 8/8 with deps installed.
Gone test asserted matching(tag)==[] the instant p.wait() returned; the SIGKILLed group's forked child was still in /proc under unwired_checks' parallel load. Now waits up to 5 s with wait_gone.

'the repair reserve is on by default from 300 copies' (line 132) builds a 252-person-week at timeBudgetMs 10000 and asserts optimality.coverRepairReserveMs === 1000; the reserve is only set once the cover passes start (~2.7 s idle, after eject ~1.4 s and scoreCG ~1 s), so on a loaded runner the budget runs out first and it reads null. Failed on PR #18785's changed-ventures job (all 511 suites ran because platform/ci changed). Tried: timeBudgetMs 30000 (scoreCG and floors scale with the budget: 32 s idle, too slow); scoreCG:false (the build then ran >200 s, ignoring its 10 s budget: a second defect worth its own look). Fix needs a way to start the cover passes early without timing (e.g. an option skipping eject, or exporting the reserve decision from buildRoster's option path), or reading the reserve from the plan before the passes run.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
